quests.instruction: Yellow on the outside, creamy white once you peel it. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Peel it and look at the color of the inside.
quests.explanation: Banana has a yellow peel and soft, creamy white flesh. Kiwi is green inside and watermelon is red.
quests.funFact: A banana plant is a giant herb, not a tree. Its "trunk" is made of tightly wrapped leaf bases.

quests.instruction: Which fruit has a peel and flesh that are the same warm color?
quests.hint: Compare the color of the peel with the color of the juicy sections.
quests.explanation: Orange has an orange peel and orange flesh. Banana is cream inside and kiwi is green inside.
quests.funFact: In some warm, humid places, oranges stay green even when they are ripe.

quests.instruction: Rough and brown on the outside, bright white on the inside. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Crack it open and look for a snowy white layer.
quests.explanation: Coconut has a brown shell and bright white flesh. Kiwi and avocado are green inside.
quests.funFact: Coconut flesh can be eaten fresh or dried, and it can also be pressed to make coconut milk.

quests.instruction: Shaped like a small football, with a little point at each end. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Look for the oval fruit instead of a round one.
quests.explanation: Lemons are oval with a small point at each end, while oranges and apples are rounder.
quests.funFact: In warm places, a lemon tree can give fruit almost all year round.

quests.instruction: This fruit is shaped like a pear but has dark, bumpy skin. Which fruit is it?
quests.hint: A real pear is smooth. Look for the one with the bumpy coat.
quests.explanation: Avocados are pear-shaped with dark, bumpy skin and green flesh inside. A real pear has smooth skin.
quests.funFact: Avocado trees can grow very tall, sometimes taller than a house.

quests.instruction: Which large, round fruit has skin that looks like a net?
quests.hint: Look for crisscross lines wrapped around the outside.
quests.explanation: Some melons, like cantaloupe, have rough skin with a net-like pattern and sweet flesh inside.
quests.funFact: Melon seeds are dried and eaten as a snack in many parts of the world.

quests.instruction: A shopper puts cabbage and spinach in the vegetable basket. Which one goes in the fruit basket?
quests.hint: A fruit grows from a flower and holds seeds.
quests.explanation: Pear is a fruit because it grows from a flower and has seeds inside. Cabbage and spinach are leafy vegetables.
quests.funFact: The tiny gritty bits you sometimes feel in a pear are called stone cells.

quests.instruction: Lemons and limes are sour. Which fruit is sweet instead?
quests.hint: Think of the juicy fruit that tastes like a sweet treat.
quests.explanation: Peaches taste sweet and juicy, while lemons and limes are very sour.
quests.funFact: Peaches, apples and strawberries all belong to the rose family.

quests.instruction: You pull off the green leafy top before eating this red fruit. Which one?
quests.hint: Its little green hat comes off before the first bite.
quests.explanation: Strawberries have a green leafy cap that is removed before eating. Blueberries have no cap, and cherries have a stem.
quests.funFact: Strawberry plants grow thin stems called runners that form new baby plants.

quests.instruction: Which fruit has smooth, shiny skin?
quests.hint: Run a finger over each one: one is spiky, one is fuzzy, and one is slick.
quests.explanation: Cherries have smooth, shiny skin. Pineapple is rough and spiky, and kiwi is fuzzy.
quests.funFact: Cherries come in colors from yellow-pink to deep purple-black.

quests.instruction: Which fruit is often sold seedless, so there is nothing to spit out?
quests.hint: Look for the small round fruit you can pop in whole.
quests.explanation: Many grapes are grown without seeds, so they are easy to eat. Peaches and cherries have a hard pit inside.
quests.funFact: Seedless grapes are grown from cuttings of a vine, not from seeds.

quests.instruction: People say this fruit has "eyes": little diamond-shaped bumps on its skin. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Look for the tropical fruit with a pattern of bumps all around.
quests.explanation: Pineapple skin is covered with diamond-shaped bumps that people call eyes. Kiwi is fuzzy and pear is smooth.
quests.funFact: A pineapple is made of many small flowers that grew together into one fruit.

quests.instruction: Smooth purple skin, juicy inside, and one hard pit in the middle. Which fruit?
quests.hint: It is bigger than a grape and has a hard center.
quests.explanation: Plums have smooth skin that is often purple, with juicy flesh around one hard pit.
quests.funFact: Some plums are dried, and dried plums are called prunes.

quests.instruction: Which fruit is made of lots of tiny round bumps stuck together, with a hollow middle?
quests.hint: Picture a soft red thimble.
quests.explanation: Raspberries are made of many tiny juicy bumps joined together. When picked, they leave a hollow center.
quests.funFact: Raspberries can be red, black, purple or even golden yellow.

quests.instruction: Tough red skin outside, juicy ruby-red seeds packed inside. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Open it up and you'll find hundreds of tiny jewels.
quests.explanation: Pomegranates have a thick, leathery skin, and inside are many juicy red seed pockets.
quests.funFact: People have grown pomegranates for thousands of years in parts of Asia and around the Mediterranean.

quests.instruction: A tropical fruit with soft orange flesh and a hollow middle full of small black seeds. Which one?
quests.hint: Scoop out the shiny black seeds before you eat.
quests.explanation: Papaya has orange flesh and a hollow center filled with small black seeds. Mango has one big flat seed instead.
quests.funFact: Papaya plants grow fast and can start giving fruit in their first year.

quests.instruction: Which citrus fruit is bigger than an orange, with a sweet-sour taste and a slightly bitter edge?
quests.hint: Look for the largest citrus fruit in the group.
quests.explanation: Grapefruit is a large citrus fruit that tastes sweet, sour and a little bitter. Its flesh can be pink, red or yellow.
quests.funFact: Grapefruit got its name because the fruits grow in clusters, a bit like grapes.

quests.instruction: A small golden-orange fruit that looks like a mini peach, with one hard pit. Which one?
quests.hint: Think of a peach's smaller cousin.
quests.explanation: Apricots are small golden-orange fruits with soft skin and one hard pit. They are relatives of peaches.
quests.funFact: Apricot trees bloom early in spring, often with pale pink or white flowers.

quests.instruction: It looks like a raspberry, but it is so dark it is almost black. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Its name tells you its color.
quests.explanation: Blackberries are clusters of juicy bumps that ripen to a deep purple-black.
quests.funFact: Blackberries grow on thorny bushes called brambles.

quests.instruction: A soft, teardrop-shaped fruit with tiny crunchy seeds inside. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Bite in and you will feel lots of tiny crunchy seeds.
quests.explanation: Figs are soft and teardrop-shaped, filled with many tiny edible seeds.
quests.funFact: A fig is really a soft case holding hundreds of tiny flowers inside.

quests.instruction: Bright pink skin with green scales, and white flesh dotted with tiny black seeds. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Its skin looks like it belongs to a mythical creature.
quests.explanation: Dragon fruit has pink skin with green scales, and white or pink flesh with tiny black seeds.
quests.funFact: Dragon fruit grows on a climbing cactus.

quests.instruction: Peaches and cherries each have one hard pit. Which other fruit belongs in the same group?
quests.hint: Check which fruit has one hard center and which have lots of small seeds.
quests.explanation: Apricots have one hard pit, like peaches and cherries. Grapes and melons have small seeds instead.
quests.funFact: Many people dry apricots so they can enjoy them all year round.

quests.instruction: Which fruit grows on a climbing cactus?
quests.hint: Remember the pink fruit with green scales.
quests.explanation: Dragon fruit grows on a climbing cactus. Papaya grows on a tall, tree-like plant, and pineapple grows close to the ground.
quests.funFact: The flowers of the dragon fruit cactus open at night.

quests.instruction: Which fruit grows on a thorny bush called a bramble?
quests.hint: Look for the dark berry.
quests.explanation: Blackberries grow on thorny brambles, so pickers must be careful. Plums grow on trees and strawberries on low plants.
quests.funFact: Wild blackberries often grow along hedges and paths in many countries.

quests.instruction: Which of these grows from a flower and holds seeds inside?
quests.hint: Think of a juicy red food that people slice into salads.
quests.explanation: Tomatoes grow from flowers and hold seeds, which makes them fruits. Onions are bulbs and lettuce is a leafy vegetable.
quests.funFact: Tomatoes can be red, yellow, orange, green or even purple.

quests.instruction: A bumpy pink-red shell outside, juicy white fruit inside with one shiny brown seed. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Peel away the bumpy shell to find a pearly surprise.
quests.explanation: Lychee has bumpy pink-red skin that peels off to show juicy white flesh around one shiny brown seed.
quests.funFact: Lychees grow in warm places, and the fruits hang in clusters.

quests.instruction: A round purple fruit with tough, wrinkly skin and juicy orange pulp full of crunchy seeds. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Cut it open and scoop out the pulp with a spoon.
quests.explanation: Passion fruit has a tough round rind and juicy pulp full of small edible seeds.
quests.funFact: Passion fruit grows on a vine with big, unusual flowers.

quests.instruction: Fuzzy skin, sweet juicy flesh, and one hard pit. Which fruit fits all three clues?
quests.hint: Check all three clues, not just one.
quests.explanation: Peach fits every clue. Kiwi is fuzzy but has tiny seeds, and avocado has one big seed but smooth skin.
quests.funFact: Peach trees start giving fruit a few years after they are planted.

quests.instruction: A leafy crown on top and diamond-shaped "eyes" on the skin. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Look for the tropical fruit that is spiky on top and bumpy all over.
quests.explanation: Pineapple has a crown of leaves on top and diamond-shaped eyes on its skin. Coconut and banana have neither.
quests.funFact: A pineapple plant takes well over a year to grow one fruit.

quests.instruction: Citrus, the same warm color all the way through, and split into juicy sections. Which fruit?
quests.hint: Pull the sections apart and look for the same color all through.
quests.explanation: Orange is a citrus fruit with orange peel and flesh in juicy sections. Lemon is yellow, and grapefruit is bigger with pink or yellow flesh.
quests.funFact: Oranges are one of the most widely grown tree fruits in the world.
